versions.changelog:
- Updated homepage URL in SKILL.md to point to the skill-specific page.
- No changes to functionality or usage—documentation and metadata update only.

Initial release of DeepSeek V4 command-line integration.

- Supports DeepSeek V4 Flash and Pro models via OpenAI-compatible API.
- Use one-shot Q&A, "thinking mode" for visible reasoning, and multi-turn chat directly from the terminal.
- Provides pricing information and usage instructions for each model.
- No special CLI required; leverages Python scripts for all operations.
- Legacy aliases deprecated as of 2026-07-24.
